audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..3].side all read "Karma" while content win[0..3] and whys[0..3] say Janna wins levels 1 through 4-5 (Karma's only early tool is a slow Q poke; her Mantra is on a long cooldown, mana can't sustain spam).
audit.why: Content's whys are grounded in real kit facts (Mantra cooldown, mana costs) and packet.levelChart agrees Janna wins rows 0-3. The full-layer side and generic why text for these rows are stale/templated and contradict the content layer.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[0..3].side to Janna (win[0..3] already correct, no content edit needed) and rewrote each why to state the grounded Janna-favored reasoning.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4..6].why describe Janna favorably ("Monsoon online", "shields grow", "Janna erases engages") while win[4..6]=Karma and content explains Karma flips ahead at 6 via Mantra uptime and stays ahead through Imperial Mandate and AoE Mantra-E peel.
audit.why: Levels 6 onward are Karma's window per packet.levelChart and content spikes[1-3]. The full-layer why text for these rows was carried over from a Janna-favored template.
audit.corrected: Moved phases[4..6].side off the flat "Skill" placeholder to Karma (matching win[4..6]) and rewrote the why text for each to state the Karma-favored reasoning grounded in Mantra uptime, Imperial Mandate, and AoE Mantra-E.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content spikes[0].text calls Karma's early poke "QE (Renewal)" — Renewal is the Mantra bonus on W (Focused Resolve, the tether/root), not on Q (Inner Flame). Content whys[5] and spikes[1].text similarly attribute her root threat to "RQ (Soulflare)" — the root lives on W, and Soul-Flare is the Q/damage Mantra bonus, not the root.
audit.why: Real Karma kit: Q Inner Flame (Mantra bonus Soul-Flare, damage), W Focused Resolve (Mantra bonus Renewal, extends the tether root), E Inspire (Mantra bonus Defiance, shield). The root threat that Imperial Mandate converts into kill setups comes from R-empowered W, not R-empowered Q.
audit.corrected: Fixed spikes[0].text to "Q (Inner Flame) poke", spikes[1].text and whys[5] to attribute the root to R-empowered W (Renewal) rather than RQ (Soulflare).
